mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 5% signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the year-over-year change in INDPRO, signals a supply shock that will drive inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y INDPRO growth drops by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 3%, it signals a tightening monetary cycle that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as credit conditions tighten.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises above 3% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) rise by more than 10% year-over-year and consumer sentiment (UMCSENT) is above its 12-month average, it signals a strengthening consumer demand environment that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST y-o-y growth > 10% AND UMCSENT > 12mo avg
failure_condition: Trigger condition met but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) is growing by more than 200,000 per month, it signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: Trigger condition met but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the 10-year Treasury yield (GS10) is rising by more than 50 basis points over the past 3 months, it signals a tightening financial conditions environment that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Trigger condition met but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (PCECC96) are growing by more than 4% year-over-year and the consumer sentiment index (UMCSENT) is above its 12-month average, it signals a strong consumer demand environment that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PCECC96 y-o-y growth > 4% AND UMCSENT > 12mo avg
failure_condition: Trigger condition met but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.
